title: lycopersicon esculentum var. pyriforme
intro: Lycopersicon esculentum var. pyriforme, commonly known as the Yellow Pear tomato, is a variety of tomato plant known for its unique, elongated shape and yellow skin. The health benefits of consuming Yellow Pear tomatoes include high levels of vitamins A and C, potassium, and lycopene, which can help protect against heart disease, certain cancers, and age-related macular degeneration. The bioactive constituents of Yellow Pear tomatoes include carotenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, contributing to its potential benefits in reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting immune function. Additionally, the therapeutic actions of Yellow Pear tomatoes may also include neuroprotective and anti-cancer properties, making it a valuable addition to a balanced diet.
